## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should preserve the revision identifier used by history. Its shorter prefix breaks the documented consistency and makes revisions sharing seven leading characters indistinguishable.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, status displays `0123456` while history displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` while history uses `revision[:12]`. Use the same 12-character prefix and assert the complete status output in the test. — Users receive inconsistent identifiers across deployment views, and revisions distinguishable in history can appear identical in running status.
